# featureflip_environment (Data Source)

Look up an environment by project and key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "featureflip_environment" "production" {
  project = "web"
  key     = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String)
- `project` (String)

### Read-Only

- `color` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `sort_order` (Number)
